versions.content: Suppress responses to diagnostic tool requests Description: The diagnostic in AUTOSAR shall support the suppressPosRspMsgIndicationBit and the defined behavior according to ISO 14229-1:2013. Rationale: The tester is not interested in the positive response in certain situations. It prevents bus burst as result of a functional request. Use Case: In most cases, the positive responses are not relevant for functional requests to set the vehicle in a certain state. This can be a sequence of service 0x85, 0x28 and functional 0x3E during reprogramming to keep the vehicle in a ’silent’ state without normal bus communication and DTC setting switched off. AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – Supporting Material: ISO14229-1 v.2013
